question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who's your favorite member of the swim team?
Which part of girls night in would be your favorite?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: So what is this movie about?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Two rival dentists who fall in love.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I would've preferred the horror movie.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Too late, our hostess picked it!
Linda starts the movie, and the girls settle back to watch it...
Halfway through...

nodes.speaker: Dr. Loveman
nodes.text: I've had it up to here with you. You're `im-plaque-able!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I've had it up to here with you. You're [color=#e23b3b][i]im-plaque-able![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: Do you know what's going on between us, Dr. Fine?

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: Other than an intense rivalry of septic proportions, no. Why don't you tell me, Dr. Loveman?

nodes.speaker: Dr. Loveman
nodes.text: We're in love!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Did he really just say that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, this is so boring!

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: Well, I have a second opinion for you. There's no way we'll ever be together!

nodes.speaker: Dr. Loveman
nodes.text: You know what I have to say to that?

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: Bite me?
Dr. Loveman grabs Dr. Fine and kisses her passionately!
After another grating hour of watching, the movie ends.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I liked it. So what'd you guys think?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What a terrible movie! Come on, 'Dr. Loveman' and 'Dr. Fine'? Who comes up with this stuff?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Blech. Was it really necessary for their wedding to take place in a dentist office?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm never going to look at teeth cleaning the same way again.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sam, that was an awful pick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, it was Linda's movie!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It wasn't `that` bad! You guys are so hard to please.
nodes.text_bbcode: It wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad! You guys are so hard to please.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE would've found a way to make me enjoy it. But right now, I'm bored, and now I just miss $ZOE even more!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: A horror movie? Really? Aren't we a little old for this?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're never too old to be scared out of your mind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I love horror movies.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Great.
Hannah starts the movie, and the girls settle back to watch.

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: Dr. Loveman, what are we going to do? How are we going to save those poor cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: Now that the lab's been taken over, we'll never figure out how to make the vaccine! Those poor girls!

nodes.speaker: Dr. Loveman
nodes.text: It gets worse, Dr. Fine. I... I have to tell you something...
Dr. Loveman peels back his sleeve to reveal the zombie bite!

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Dr. Loveman
nodes.text: I understand if you have to leave me.

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: I could never leave you.

nodes.speaker: Dr. Loveman
nodes.text: Not even if I turn into a zombie?

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: Not even then!

nodes.speaker: Dr. Loveman
nodes.text: `RAWR!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]RAWR![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dr. Fine
nodes.text: `Ahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ahhh!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Ha ha ha, that was awesome!
As the movie plays...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: This is the really good part where she has to axe her way out of the safehouse and flee to the tower.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why? Why would she leave?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Because the zombies figured out how to turn door handles!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE never liked these movies... It's nice being around people that do.
After the movie...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't usually like horror movies, but that was fun!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: That was one of the best horror movies ever!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I still miss $ZOE, but... This is kind of nice too.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I think it's cool you're so devoted to swimming that you can follow such a strict diet.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks. It's a hard regimen to follow.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I bet. You know, I heard just recently that most male athletes just eat junk.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Who's really surprised by that?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh yeah, isn't there an Olympic swimmer who eats like two pizzas a day?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If Taylor heard that, she'd have a heart attack thinking about all the calories.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ha ha. If only.
The girls finish up eating.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So what should we do?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I was thinking maybe we should do something for dessert.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: None for me, thanks. But I'll go along with you guys.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about baking cookies? I think we have the stuff we need for chocolate chip.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's what $ZOE and I did together whenever my Mom was out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She had this special recipe that we'd always use. It was delicious. The chocolate was all melty, and the cookie edges were crunchy...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That sounds divine.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, let's make those! You lead, Sam. You must be an expert at making them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wouldn't say that.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Just tell us what to do.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, you can make cookies without $ZOE. This night can be fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Except that $ZOE did all the baking... And I did most of the eating...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How do I bake cookies again?

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Help Sam bake! Choose the right steps!

nodes.text: Sam puts the cookies in the oven.
Twenty minutes later, she pulls the baking sheets out of the oven.
The smell of delicious cookies wafts throughout the house.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I did it! I made $ZOE's cookies!
All the girls except Sara take one and try it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And they're awesome!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Why have you never made these before now?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: They're the best cookies I've ever smelled.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE would've really loved them.
The girls eat the rest of the cookies.
Twenty minutes later, she pulls the baking sheets out of the oven.
The smell of burnt food fills the house...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Why does it smell like burning plastic in here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think there might be bits of cutting board in the dough...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I prefer sugar cookie to cutting board.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't know. It could give it that extra crunch.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ewww... That's... Just unsafe.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, girls. Maybe next time.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Next time, I'm buying them from Kim.
The girls throw the burnt cookies away.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, what should we do now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Want to watch a movie?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah!
The girls go into Sam's room to watch a movie on her laptop.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I brought over some movies. There's 'Till Breath Do Us Part'... It's kind of a romantic comedy about dentists.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I haven't seen it, but the story's supposed to be really good.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, I brought a horror movie with me, 'Cheerleaders Versus Zombies'. The acting's awful, but the main guy's really cute.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh great. The tag line of the movie is 'Can the cheerleading squad use pom-poms to prevent nom-noms'? How lame is that?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't know which one I'd dislike more. The movie that defines a woman by the relationships she has with men...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Or a movie that sounds like it's going to feature pom-poms in miniskirts.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm not sure which movie I'd want to see. Sam, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I love horror movies, but $ZOE used to make me watch romantic comedies all the time...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's watch...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He's not mean. He's just very invested in my training.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He thinks it's important that I don't go overboard.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And he wants the same thing I do... High performance.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's what I'd call discipline.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't want to offend you..

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, you didn't.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You know, that's what I always used to tell him!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And he can be really uptight sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I have to say, it's kind of nice knowing your schedule and having your life planned out.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But where's the excitement? The rush?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Half of the fun of getting up in the morning is wondering what's going to happen.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I think we all have different ideas of what's fun in life.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll say. I wouldn't enjoy acting as much as Hannah or playing soccer like Linda.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, sweetheart, he's just saying that. I don't think he's any less upset than you are.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But he is right. There's no more $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sometimes these things happen. People have different paths in life.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And right now, $ZOE belongs with her parents.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean she's out of your life. You can talk to each other on the phone or email each other, can't you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, but that's different. I won't get to hang out with her in person. So what should I do now?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You're a charming girl, Sam. You have other friends. It's time to start building those relationships again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not close to anyone else. I'm not really part of the cheerleading group anymore...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: What about the swim team?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know. I get along with them, but I can't say we're close friends.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, you're going to be spending a lot of time with them. You could become close friends.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Why don't you invite them over? Have a sleepover?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't really `do` sleepovers.
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't really [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] sleepovers.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Don't be silly. Everyone can 'do a sleepover'. You'll be doing the same things you used to do with $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Eat dinner, bake cookies, watch a movie, talk about which boys are the best kissers...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mom!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sleepovers are fun. And I'm sure it'll show you that $ZOE isn't the only person you can have fun with.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, but can we not call it a sleepover? It seems so middle school.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know! I'll have a girls night in!
A week later, the swim team arrives at Sam's house for a girls night in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah, glad you and Linda could make it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm really excited. It's going to be so nice to have some alone time with girls.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: This will be really fun. You girls haven't had a real girls night until you've had one with me!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Do we have the house all to ourselves?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For now. My mom's working late, but she'll be back later.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Perfect.
Behind them, Jane walks up.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: A girls night in? Good job subverting male-dominated thought by renaming the event.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sleepovers don't just consist of girls having pillow fights!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: They don't?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No! We're here for our own unmitigated enjoyment.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! Great!
And behind Jane is Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sara, you're here! You convinced your dad to let you stay over?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Kind of. He's okay with me spending the night as long as I'm rested enough for swimming practice tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But tomorrow's Sunday.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, that's the day I have the most free time, so that's when we schedule the long-distance runs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, it's good you're here, I guess. Not a swim team girls night without the captain, right?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah.
Sam leads them into the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, you're just in time. The pizza's here.
The girls dig in. Sam looks over and sees Sara with an empty plate.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sara, is everything okay with the food?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh yeah. I'm just... On a special diet. So I brought my own.
Sara brandishes a brown paper bag and starts pulling out her dinner.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A canister of almonds... Two cups of yogurt... Some bananas...
Sara keeps pulling out bags and plastic tins.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A bag of raisins... A pint of milk... Two peanut butter sandwiches on wheat toast...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whoa, girl, is there an end to that bag? Your dinner's taking up half the table.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How do you eat that much?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, when you swim, you actually need to eat a lot of calories...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: If I trained that hard, I wouldn't be eating milk and bananas.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'd drink milk shakes all the time.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, my dad wants me to be healthy. So he created this meal plan for me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's what I eat every day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, your dad is...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's what you say when nothing is going right.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You're a teenager, Sam, and I know it's not cool to tell your mom anything.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Trust me, I tried my best to make sure my mom didn't interfere with my life...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But you can always talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great. I just made my mom sad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not that. It's complicated.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Is it because $ZOE left?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! She's gone, and she's never coming back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Howard, that jerk, is already telling me that I should move on...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? Why are you happy?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh no, dear, I'm just glad you feel you can talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mom...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: No, it's okay! Please, tell me what's 'awful' about everything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE's gone, and she's never coming back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Howard said he'd already moved on, and I should too!
Sam turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just what do you think `you're` doing?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just what do you think [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] doing?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You were flirting with Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wasn't! She just came up and talked to me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How could you just disrespect $ZOE like that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Disrespect $ZOE? How am I doing that? You need to calm down, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Calm down? Calm down?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's only been gone for one morning, and you're already looking for your next girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that why you wanted to come to this party?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I wanted to come to this party to keep my mind off $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: With another girl!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not why I came!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And besides, it's time to snap out of it, Sam. $ZOE's gone, and she's not coming back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just trying to move on.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You should probably do the same.
Howard storms away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! Run away! See if I care!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can you believe that? He's impossible!
Sam looks around and realizes she's talking to no one!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's right... Without $ZOE... Who am I going to talk to?
For the rest of the party, Sam looks for her new $ZOE.
From the basketball team...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We just dropped her off at the airport this morning...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wait, who are we talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE? My cousin? The one that left us all behind?
To the cheerleading squad...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So do you think the jean miniskirt is going to make a comeback?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not sure, but...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor at twelve!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam, we have to go. Taylor's still mad at you. If she sees us with you...
Maria and Nicole make a run for it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, okay... Bye...
...To the people from the newspaper club!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I just got so mad at him! How could he do that to her?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You seem like you have a lot of repressed anger.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't repress anything!
Sam punches a table.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm just going to, uh, watch from over there.
Sam is hard-pressed to find a friend.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The truth of the matter is... I don't know if I'll ever be able to replace $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think you're supposed to replace her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess that's true. You know, you're the best not-$ZOE so far...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, thanks?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My best advice is... Maybe you just need a different set of friends. Like I have the nerds for my problems.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe. But for now, I'm going home.
Sam leaves the pool party sadly.
Later that night, in her room...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe Howard is just going to move on like that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Doesn't he care at all?!
At that moment, there's a knock at Sam's door.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sam? Can I come in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You were really upset when you came home earlier.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Is everything okay?
Sam pushes Howard!
He rocks back on his heels.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, Sam! You could've toppled both of us into the pool.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, what was that for, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was for...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Never mind. I don't care. I don't want to deal with you when you're angry.
Jessica leaves.
Sam shoves Jessica!
Surprised, Jessica tumbles forward into Howard! They fall to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm fine, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sam, what was `that` for?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, what was [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] for?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For talking to a guy who's already taken!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, we were just talking! Forget this, I'm leaving.
Jessica turns to Howard and smiles.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks for catching me, Howard... I'll see you around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, 'catch' you later.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Tee-hee.
Jessica leaves.
Howard pulls up along the curbside.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, here we are. The airport.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am going to miss you so much, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, me too.
$ZOE pulls Sam into a giant hug.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had so much fun with you. Sniffle... You'll always be my sister.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'll always be my sister, too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't cry. You're going to make me cry, and I hate it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Goodbye, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Goodbye, $ZOE.
The girls hug then pull away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess I'll let you say good bye to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam.
Sam leaves the car, and $ZOE and Howard turn to each other.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So this is it, huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too, Howard.
Howard and $ZOE embrace for the last time.
Tears streaming down her face, $ZOE exits the car, grabs her luggage, and walks into the terminal.
Sam climbs into the car.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that was fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or the complete opposite.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was being sarcastic. Come on, Howard, take me home.
As Howard pulls in front of what was once $ZOE's house...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you going to go to Hector's pool party this afternoon?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not really in the mood.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not either, but I think it would be good to see some friends.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll think about it. Thanks, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. See you later.
Sam climbs out of the car.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Later.
At Hector's party that afternoon, Sam arrives alone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fantastic. Without $ZOE, I don't even have any friends!
Around her, students run around, celebrating summer...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whoo hoo! Cannon ball! Whee!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Consider the pool 'Spiked'!
And over by the deck chairs...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This is the perfect time for a tan!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Any time there's sun is the perfect time for a tan, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't see the connection...
And over by the pool, the swim team hangs out.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm going to swim a couple of laps. Anyone want to join?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No thanks. I'm not in training, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My dad says a true athlete is always in training.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I'll swim. There's nothing exciting going on right now.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Speak for yourself. I see something plenty exciting over there.
Hannah points at some tough-looking guys in leather jackets at the edge of the party.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: They look like bikers! They're so dreamy. Linda, you like bad boys. Come on!
Hannah drags Linda over to talk to the boys, as Sam looks on sadly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wonder where Howard is... At least he's feeling as miserable as I am...
Suddenly, Sam spies Howard and Jessica talking near the drink table!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You seem like a kind and sensitive guy, Howard.
Jessica puts a hand on Howard's arm.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow, Howard, your biceps feel so strong! You football jocks are so in shape.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We do work out a lot at practices...
Sam jumps up and walks right up to Howard and Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's not really up to me. My parents want me to live with them in France.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They specifically chose a city that has an international school they think would be good for me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They miss me. And I miss them a lot, and I want to stay with them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sounds like you can't wait to get away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't be like that, Sam. I'm going to miss being here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go ahead and do whatever you want.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... You don't have to pretend to be so tough. You're going to miss me, and I'm definitely going to miss you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't really want to move to France.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's going to stay up with me and watch romantic comedies? Who's going to stand up for me when someone is picking on me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's going to be my best friend?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess you'll just have to find someone else.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And how am I going to do that? Without you, I'm just going to get myself in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you know the only thing I can say in French is 'Je m'apelle Amanda'?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Heh.
The girls open the front door carefully and let themselves out.
Sam closes the door silently behind them. Outside, the girls sigh with relief.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We made it! Now come on, my car's down the street.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are we all going to fit in your car?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We'll squeeze if we have to.
Sam and the swim team run away, out through the gates, into the parking lot, and straight to Hannah's car!
The girls throw open their doors! Hannah starts the engine!
As cops close around the track, Sam and the other girls escape!
Sam tries to run but stumbles! She tries to stand up, but finds her foot is caught painfully in some wood!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ow, my ankle! It's stuck! Help! Help me!
Though she shouts, the scared crowd of people ignores her and runs, trying to avoid capture!
A couple minutes later, Sam sits alone in the darkness as Officer Monte walks up.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, well, well... If it isn't the little Bonnie herself.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Thought you'd outrun me, but got caught in your own trap!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Your parents will probably want to know where you are.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, what about my friends?
Sam looks around and realizes the swim team has scattered with the rest of the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: There's no one here but you and me. Come on, you're out way past your bedtime.
Oh no! Sam got caught by the police?! Try again and see if you can keep Sam out of trouble this time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's over. At least nothing else can go wrong tonight...

Officer Monte slides out of his car with a megaphone in hand!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: All right, break it up!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: This is the police! You are all engaging in an illegal activity!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Everyone, freeze!

nodes.text: `Run!`

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Let's go!

nodes.text: `I'm` the one that runs away?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one that runs away?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The last time I checked, `you` were the one that walked away from our last talk.
nodes.text_bbcode: The last time I checked, [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] were the one that walked away from our last talk.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You broke up with me! What was I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We broke up again because of Denni! You like her! You said so yourself!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I told you, it doesn't matter. I don't get why you can't get that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't have to understand it. You just have to hear what I'm saying.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why don't you try to think about someone else for once in your life?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not the one who's selfish here!
Sam launches herself at Colt!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Whoa, wait! Don't do that!
The other girls pull Sam off.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're crazy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Only because you make me that way!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know why I even bother.
Colt leaves, and the other girls drag Sam away from Colt.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That got ugly fast.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's pretty much every fight we have.

nodes.text: Just leave him alone, Sam. We don't have to listen to him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What would $ZOE tell me to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam

Sam stops for the briefest moment to look back at a forlorn Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to argue with you anymore. You're just not good for me. Let's leave it at that.
Sam and the swim team turn their backs on him.

nodes.text: And we have our racers! Racers, get to the starting line!
Sam is watching the race unfold when she sees a familiar face...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh my gosh, it's Colt! He's here! And he's coming over to us!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's leave right now.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But the race is starting now!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know, but it's Colt.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Maybe it's a sign, Sam. Maybe you're supposed to run into him now. To talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't believe in signs.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't either, but maybe Hannah's right. This could be your chance to get everything off your chest.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I already got everything off my chest at Prom! I don't want to live through that again.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: He still seems to be harassing you, doesn't he?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I say we ignore him, Sam. You don't really want to talk to him, do you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm all for ignoring guys that cause you trouble. I ran into Kenji earlier and walked right past him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's too late.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Colt. I thought I told you not to call me that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, things happen. Didn't think I'd see you here. This doesn't seem like your scene.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Call me surprised. Isn't it past your curfew or something?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's none of your business, Colt. I don't have to answer that. You're not my boyfriend anymore.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm glad for that. I hope you didn't come because you want to get back together and break up again...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey... That's not fair.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No way you're letting him off the hook. Tell him what you have to say!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I've been missing this kind of drama since I left theater club.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Staying doesn't seem like such a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right...
Linda starts to draw Sam away.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So that's how it is? You're just going to walk away?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll be here for two races, tops. That won't take more than an hour.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then after that, we'll be home.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, Sara. They drive fast here.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, it `is` a race.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a race.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And don't worry about my mom. I've snuck out before, and it's fine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She won't check in on us because she wants us to have fun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And she's a sound sleeper anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, if you say so. But no more than two races.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That's all I want to see...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, that, and the cute biker guy I saw at the pool party...
The girls turn to watch the race.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How do you know that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Because... I just... Do?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's so reassuring.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What Sam means to say is...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: People have these races all the time, and the cops don't bust them.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, not usually.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Not usually?! I can't afford to get caught here! Not by the police!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sara, you're being overly dramatic. And that's coming from me.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Just cool it. We won't be here long. We'll be home before you know it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Huff.... Huff... Okay, I'm okay, but can we just get out of here as soon as we can?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: One race. And then we'll go.
The girls turn to watch the race.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Here we are!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: This place looks...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Rough?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Not the word I was looking for.
Riders, motorcycle enthusiasts, and all around tough rebels mill around, talking about the big race.
At the center of everything, Hawk Gunner narrates the events!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hawk declares that racers report! Racers, get geared up and ready to go!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Tonight, you will see the talented, the scary... Crushing Blow!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Crushing Blow is racing? This is gonna be awesome!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Up against Centerscore's one and only... The Windowbreaker!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I've never seen The Windowbreaker in action!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: The Windowbreaker? That name's kinda lame.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: No, it's not! He goes so fast, the force of his fastness breaks everything, including windows! This is gonna rock!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You got that right.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I've never seen so many bikers in my life.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You and me both.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Isn't it spectacular?! So many hot hunks of junk...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: The motorcycles or the guys?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like I haven't heard that one before. Both!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: All riiiiiight! Place your bets before the heats start!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: For you lucky Hawk-ettes out there... The Hawk is going to give a special performance this evening...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Be there... Or beware! The Hawk strikes!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Did that make sense to anyone else?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It means Hawk Gunner is going to be racing!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wait, did he say to place bets? Isn't that illegal?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's not illegal to gamble.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes, it is! It is if you're underage, gambling on an `illegal` street race! Which is where we are!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, it is! It is if you're underage, gambling on an [color=#3b78e2][i]illegal[/i][/color] street race! Which is where we are!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Trust me, Sara, stay cool, and it'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hannah, this is not where you promised you'd take us!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I said it would be an athletic competition...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I thought you meant a legitimate, safe, clean bike event!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You really think something like that is going to start at midnight?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We're going to get into so much trouble for this!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I bet Sam's mom already found out that we snuck out.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And then my dad's going to find out next! And then he's going to kill me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sara, calm down. You're starting to freak people out.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, everyone's staring at us, and that's never good when you're surrounded by thugs!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We have to get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sara, relax...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sam?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mom! What are you doing up?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I heard some noises from down here. I figured you girls wanted a midnight snack, and I'd make something for you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But why are you all dressed up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It was my idea. We wanted to go out.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Out? It's nearly midnight on a Saturday. Where are you going to go?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: To the racetrack.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sara, don't you mean the store called The Racetrack?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Hannah, don't be silly. It hasn't been that long since I've been a teenager.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I used to sneak out all the time when my parents were asleep, and get into all kinds of trouble.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So you'll let us go?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Did you not hear the part where I said I used to get into all kinds of trouble? I'm going to have to call all of your parents.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sit down, girls, It's going to be a long night for everyone.
As Sam's mom makes phone calls, the other girls think about what they've done.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This doesn't look good.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm probably going to get grounded.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I can't believe we're getting in trouble for this.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My dad's never going to let me sleep over again.
Oh no! Sam's sleepover was a disaster! Try again and see if you can get everyone out of the house this time!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Good going, Sara! We're trying to sneak out `quietly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Good going, Sara! We're trying to sneak out [color=#3b78e2][i]quietly.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's not as easy to see in the dark as you might think.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whatever, let's get out of here. The door's right there!
Sam dives for the bowl and catches it safely in her hands!
The magazine lands quietly on the ground beside her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No harm done. The door's right there! Let's get out of here!
The swim team walks through the dining area quickly and quietly until...
Sara knocks over a magazine and bowl of fruit from the table!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `OW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]OW![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Are you `trying` to wake your mom up?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you [color=#3b78e2][i]trying[/i][/color] to wake your mom up?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Shut up and get moving!
Sam slaps a hand over her mouth to keep from crying out...
It works!
Sam rushes to keep up with the group.
As the girls head towards the kitchen, Hannah accidentally tramps hard on Sam's foot!
Sam catches herself!
Hannah nods approvingly and motions her forward.
Sam falls forward onto the carpet with a thud!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Sam!` This is not the time to be a klutz.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam![/i][/color] This is not the time to be a klutz.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Shh! Let's keep moving, please?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Look, we're only young once. When are you going to let go and have fun?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess doing all the things I used to do with $ZOE are just making me miss her more...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe Howard was right. Maybe it is time to move on.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay. Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: As soon as your mom is asleep.
After a short time, when the light in her mom's room goes out, Sam and the other girls tiptoe downstairs, whispering quietly.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I feel like a kid on the night before Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, a really naughty kid.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Girls, I don't think this is a great idea.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You don't have to come with us if you don't want to.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, I'm coming. I'm just saying. This doesn't seem wise.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Okay, you guys, shush up. If we're going to sneak out, everyone needs to be quiet.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We have to get through the living room, cross the kitchen, and then make a run for the door.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But don't bump into anything. And don't make a noise. Let's go!
Sam runs along behind Hannah but clips the side of a chair and trips!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just don't feel comfortable going behind my mom's back.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You can't go behind your mom's back if you never told her about it.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Think about it, she only told us to go to sleep early.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: She didn't say anything about having to stay in the house!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I do have a curfew...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're having a sleepover. Curfews don't count.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think it's a good idea... I mean, do we all have to go with you? Maybe some of us could stay here.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'd stay here.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're just using your mom as an excuse because you're too much of a wuss to go.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I thought you were supposed to be some kind of super-awesome bad girl who didn't worry about getting into trouble.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am! I totally am!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Why does Colt have anything to do with this?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt has everything to do with this. Not only is he my ex-boyfriend, but he loves motorcycles!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh, right.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But, that doesn't mean he'll `be` there tonight.
nodes.text_bbcode: But, that doesn't mean he'll [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] there tonight.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you joking? That is exactly the place he'd be going on Saturday night.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But you don't know until you go. If he's there, we'll leave. Simple as that.
At that moment, Sam's mom comes home!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Girls?
Sam's mom opens the bedroom door.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Hello. Just wanted to let you know I'm home if you needed anything. What are you up to?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, the usual. Just talking, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I know what that's about. I'll get out of your way then.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Yawn. It's been a long day. I'm going to bed. Just don't stay up too late.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure thing, Mom. Good night!
Sam's mom leaves.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So what are we going to do? Got anything else planned?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Geez, Hannah, you've been asking us all night what we're doing next. I don't think any of us have it all thought out.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, maybe I have something we can do.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Remember those biker guys I talked to at the party last week?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: After you left, they told me about a race that's going on tonight at the Skyway Racetrack!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't tell me you want to go.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I so want to go! It'll be fun. Come on, you girls are all single, right?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't see what that has to do with anything.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Let's just say there will be hot boys.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I still don't see why I should care.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Even if you're, like, super feminist, Jane, you can still appreciate cute boys, can't you?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And don't you think sneaking out at night to do whatever you want is kind of thrilling?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It does feel like I'm asserting my independence by flaunting parental law...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sneak out? But we told Sam's mom we'd sleep early!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And her mom said she was going to bed. We can leave for a couple hours, come back, sleep in, and she'll never figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't feel comfortable about this.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sara, have you ever been to a motorcycle race before?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, no...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You have to come then! And it's a totally legit, athletic event. You love those! You'll be watching a race up close and personal!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Except it'll be bikes instead of swimmers!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, okay!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sam, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think I want to go.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aw, come on, Sam. Why not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because of...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about Jane?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't think I should start.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Jane, don't tell me you're having trouble getting guys.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: That's not the problem. The problem is that most guys aren't worth getting.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Guys, especially high school guys, are just too immature. They don't understand what I'm all about.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You mean, feminism and stuff?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Feminism and stuff? Those are my ideological and political beliefs you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Look, I didn't mean anything by it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, why don't we... Do something else now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about you, Linda?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I've just gotten over all my boy troubles.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: All your boy troubles?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah. Howard and Kenji? Having one person you love is hard enough. But having two?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It took a long time to be able to let both of them go.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I was just so angry all the time, and I didn't even know what to do.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, Linda went through a really hard time with her breakup...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe my mom's right. Maybe Howard is just so upset about $ZOE that he threatened to move on...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But everything turned out fine. I feel better than ever.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I'm ready to date again.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What about you, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about me?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, when you first joined the swim team, you were really upset about Colt kissing Denni.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But it's been a while now... Is there anything else going on with you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Any new boys?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, no one new. There was a moment when Colt and I got back together.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You went back to him?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I did not `go back.` I had a moment of weakness. Then I broke up with him.
nodes.text_bbcode: I did not [color=#3b78e2][i]go back.[/i][/color] I had a moment of weakness. Then I broke up with him.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Good. He cheated on you, Sam. A guy like that's not worth keeping around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know, Jane. I'm still mad at him, and there are things I want to say to him, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I finally realized that... It's just not a good idea for me and Colt to be together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe someday we'll be together, but I'd have to forgive him first, and that will take a long time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As hard as that is for me to admit.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about Sara?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Me? I'm not sure my love life is the most interesting...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Love life? Is there a special someone?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No! I mean...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't really have a love life at all.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, I see.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We can stop talking about it if you want.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, why don't we do something else?
After Sam has turned the movie off...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what now?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We could talk about boys... I used to do that with $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hee hee. I'll go first.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I like bikers!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We all know that. Who else has stuff to share?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't want to talk about Colt... I'd better choose someone else first.

nodes.text: After a short time, when the light in her mom's room goes out, Sam and the other girls tiptoe downstairs, whispering quietly.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I feel like a kid on the night before Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, a really naughty kid.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Girls, I don't think this is a great idea.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You don't have to come with us if you don't want to.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, I'm coming. I'm just saying. This doesn't seem wise.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Okay, you guys, shush up. If we're going to sneak out, everyone needs to be quiet.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We have to get through the living room, cross the kitchen, and then make a run for the door.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But don't bump into anything. And don't make a noise. Let's go!
Sam runs along behind Hannah but clips the side of a chair and trips!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Colt. I thought I told you not to call me that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, things happen. Didn't think I'd see you here. This doesn't seem like your scene.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Call me surprised. Isn't it past your curfew or something?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's none of your business, Colt. I don't have to answer that. You're not my boyfriend anymore.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm glad for that. I hope you didn't come because you want to get back together and break up again...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey... That's not fair.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No way you're letting him off the hook. Tell him what you have to say!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I've been missing this kind of drama since I left theater club.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Staying doesn't seem like such a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right...
Linda starts to draw Sam away.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So that's how it is? You're just going to walk away?
Sam and the other girls drive home and sneak quietly into Sam's bedroom.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Whew! I'm glad that's over. I'm going to sleep.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Same here. It's really late.
The girls lay out sleeping bags on the floor and stretch out in them.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Thanks for coming out, everyone. That was a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Except for the part where we almost got caught by the police.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Even that was a little exciting, right?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like being fugitives on the run.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hannah, I worry about you.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, don't. I know how to get myself out of trouble.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It `was` fun. I wish we had gotten to see a race, though.
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] fun. I wish we had gotten to see a race, though.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, you win some, you lose some, right?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Good night, you guys.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good night.
The next morning, after a nice breakfast, the swim team packs to leave.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, Sam, it's been real. See you at practice tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks for having me over. I hope next time we don't stay up as late.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, next time we're definitely having it at my house, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Next time.
The girls leave, and Sam closes the door behind her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, that wasn't so bad, was it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, it wasn't at all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I still miss $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I know, sweetheart. But there's nothing you can do about it.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'm glad you took the first steps to moving on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... You know what, Mom? There's something I have to do today. I'll see you later!
Sam leaves the house...
And winds up on Howard's doorstep.
Howard answers the door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, Sam, it's you. Listen, about last week...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I came over because I wanted to apologize.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry too. I shouldn't have been so hard on you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I was mad because I missed $ZOE, and there you were, the only other person who was supposed to understand...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you looked like you were flirting with Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She complimented me, yes, but I wasn't flirting with her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know. I didn't come over here to talk to you about that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I had a girls night in this weekend...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And hanging out with everyone made me realize that I need $ZOE in my life.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's the person who keeps me balanced and stops me from flying off the handle.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, I almost got arrested by the police because I couldn't stand Colt!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Where are you going with this, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I miss her too, but $ZOE's not coming back. I meant it when I said the only thing we can do is move on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually... That's not the only thing we can do.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What else is there?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We can get $ZOE back!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't think that's going to work.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why not? We just need a couple plane tickets to Europe. It'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We can travel there easily enough, but that doesn't mean she's going to come home.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Her parents won't let her go. Besides, she `wants` to be with her parents.
nodes.text_bbcode: Her parents won't let her go. Besides, she [color=#e23b3b][i]wants[/i][/color] to be with her parents.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought if I suggested it, you'd say 'yes'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sam, I'd jump on the first plane going out if it meant she could come back, but it's not going to happen.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you won't help me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam. It'll take a long time for me to get over $ZOE, but I'm going to do exactly what I'm telling you now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Move on.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Move on.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard says good bye and shuts the door.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You may not believe in the plan, Howard, but one way or another, I will bring $ZOE home!
Howard just shut the door in Sam's face? Well, this may not `seem` like the best ending, but it is!
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard just shut the door in Sam's face? Well, this may not [b]seem[/b] like the best ending, but it is!

nodes.text: Good job! Sam figured out that she needs her cousin! But will she be able to bring $ZOE back?
And what will Howard do? Will he really move on? Find out in the next Surviving High School!

nodes.text: In the car on the way home...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, so my mom's probably still asleep. It'll be really easy to sneak back into the house if we go through the back door...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Actually, Sam, I'm going to stop you right there.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: This whole thing isn't working for me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The plan to get back inside?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No, the entire evening. It's been... Well, kind of boring.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You dragged us to an illegal racetrack!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, and you didn't even plan that part!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm just saying that I don't think you're the kind of person I want to hang out with.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, fine. Don't hang out with us. The other girls and I can have a fun sleepover without you.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Actually, I didn't really have that much fun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why not? Too girly?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Exactly! The entire evening just seemed like it was catering to stereotypes of female domesticity.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Baking cookies, watching movies, talking about men...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That part was fine by me, Jane.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's the part where we almost got caught by the police that really bothered me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Again, that was Hannah's idea.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But Hannah didn't sneak us out of your house, did she?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, forget you. Sara, do you have anything to add?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, they pretty much covered it all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine, I don't want to hang out with any of you `ever again.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine, I don't want to hang out with any of you [color=#3b78e2][i]ever again.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let me out of this car, so you can go do whatever it is lame people do.
Sam lets herself out on the sidewalk as the car speeds away.
She walks home alone.
The next morning...
Sam is sitting at the dining table when her mother comes in.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Hey, sweetheart, where are your friends?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Aren't they going to have breakfast?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They left already. Earlier this morning.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think I'm going to be having any more sleepovers with them.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, I'm sad to hear it didn't work out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going back to bed to figure out what else I'm going to do with myself now that I have no more friends.
And for the rest of summer, Sam went from friend group to friend group, looking for her place in the world.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So you think you can hang with us?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Do you know anything about cars?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like riding in them...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Get out!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...So I don't have any friends. I was wondering if you wanted to form our own group.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks but no thanks. I find I prefer my own company to that of others.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And friendships often end poorly for me. I tend not to form these 'close connections', if you will.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, okay...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I can't even hang out with the nerds?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You can, if you want. But we don't really have anything in common.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Unless you like talking about math, science, or physics.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like physics. It's important to work out.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's phys ed...
At last, Sam turns desperate and arrives on the doorstep of...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hello, strange friend! You were once the non-mating companion of the insipid whale.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Hey, I was wondering. Do you want to be friends?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You were friends with that $ZOE, and $ZOE was Howard's attachment...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: If I become your friend, I am much more related to $ZOE than I was before...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Which means Howard will look at me as a baker looks upon another's croissant!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, sure?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I will be proud to be your friend! We can perform eating rituals in the cafeteria and do some hang outs in the coffee shops!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You will be the friend I find first!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you'll be my new best friend too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who needs $ZOE when I have you?

Just what was Howard doing at the pool party before Sam showed up?
A week earlier, on the day Howard dropped $ZOE off at the airport...
Howard arrives alone at Hector's party.
All these people... And the one person I want to be with... Isn't here.
Hector comes up to Howard.
Hey, you look bummed out.
I took $ZOE to the airport this morning. She's flying to France.
She's probably there right now... Meeting her parents... Moving into her new home... Finding out about the awesome international school she's going to attend...
Meeting suave and romantic French guys...
Hector slaps Howard upside the head.
Come on. Don't talk like that. She's been gone less than a day, and you're already pining over her like a lovesick loon.
Of course I'm thinking about her! She just left.
My point is... You can't think about French dudes moving in on $ZOE when she's probably homesick already, crying, and thinking of you.
Well, that just makes me feel worse.
It's going to be hard on both of you, but what you need to do, my friend, is move on.
Move on? It's only been a few hours!
Strike while your sad heart is beating hot.
What does that even mean? Have you been hanging around Astrid again?
The girl's on the cheerleading squad. I'm bound to catch whatever she's got.
The crazy?
We all have it in us.
So you're telling me to forget about $ZOE and move on?
I'm not even asking you to forget about $ZOE. Just move on. Live the life. Dream the dream. Live the dream.
And that dream is...?
Dating! Dating is the ultimate dream.
Says the man in a stable relationship.
Hey, most people pay for my advice.
Anyway, I'll catch you later. I hope you listen to what I have to say.
Yeah, man. See you around.
Howard walks to one end of the party and leans against a wall.
Move on, huh? I can't do that. It's impossible.
As Howard contemplates life without $ZOE, Jessica comes up to him.
Hey, Howard.
Hi, Jessica. How's it going?
Great, except... You're kind of blocking my way to my cup. I left it here.
Oh, sorry.
Howard moves away, and Jessica grabs her cup and takes a sip.
So what's got you so down? You have a real gloomy face on.
I drove $ZOE to the airport this morning. She's left for good.
Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't know she was leaving so soon.
Yeah, I'm trying to live life without her. And it's... Harder than I thought.
Well, take it easy. You're hurt enough as it is.
Thanks, Jessica. I appreciate that.
$ZOE was lucky to have you.
You seem like a kind and sensitive guy, Howard.
Jessica puts a hand on Howard's arm.
Wow, your biceps are so strong! You football jocks are so in shape.
Uh... Thanks?
We do work out a lot at practices...
Maybe being single is kind of nice...
And that's when Howard hears heavy footsteps coming quickly behind him!
